# gx

> gx is a CLI for code review. It reads the change you are about to ship,
> holds it against the session that produced it, and gives you a ship /
> no-ship verdict. It runs on your own model API key.

## Docs

- [How it works](https://gx.run/docs/how-it-works): What gx captures, what gx review does with it, and where the two differ in a local install.
- [Getting Started](https://gx.run/docs/): Install gx, initialize a repository, and review your first change.
- [CLI](https://gx.run/docs/cli): CLI Reference with flags, examples, and exit codes.
- [MCP](https://gx.run/docs/mcp): Connect the gx MCP server to Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other MCP clients.
- [Pull Requests](https://gx.run/docs/pull-requests): Posting the gx review comment on a pull request.
- [gx changelog: new features, updates, and fixes](https://gx.run/docs/changelog/overview): Changelog for gx covering new features, product updates, CLI improvements, review workflow changes, and bug fixes.
